description: Free exam voucher for the official GitHub Foundations certification exam included with verified GitHub Student Developer Pack membership, covering Git, repositories, collaboration, and GitHub Actions fundamentals.

requirements.payment_method_notes: No payment card required when redeeming the 100% student voucher through GitHub Education.

validity.duration: Valid until voucher expiration date while enrolled
validity.auto_renewal: Does not auto-charge; single-use certification exam voucher.

restrictions: Requires approved GitHub Student Developer Pack verification.
Applies specifically to the GitHub Foundations exam; advanced specialty exams may have separate pricing.

eligibility.conditions: Verified degree- or diploma-granting student aged 13+ enrolled in an accredited institution and approved for GitHub Education.

claims.quote: Students verified for the GitHub Student Developer Pack receive a complimentary exam voucher for the GitHub Foundations certification.

verification.notes: Verified via GitHub Education partner directory and GitHub Certifications documentation.
